Spotlight: 100,000euros daughter of No Nay Never; stable has had a first-time-out 2yo winner here in the Jaber Abdullah silks this season; would need considering if the betting speaks in her favour.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Showed ability in maidens at Pontefract (6f, good) and Hamilton (5f, good to firm) in June without achieving a great deal; capable of better at some point.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Starspangledbanner half-sister to 6f winner The Untamed (RPR 80); dam 6f 2yo winner (95); David Allan is on the yard's other newcomer but she's bred to have a future and is worth a second look in the betting.

RaceName: Racing TV Club Day EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promise in three 5f runs in Ireland in the spring; well beaten in the Albany at Royal Ascot on yard debut but bounced back when fourth of eight in 6f Newmarket Listed race (good to firm) seven weeks ago, no extra late on and shaping as if this return to a stiff 5f may be ideal; sets a good standard for the rest to aim at.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Bumped into useful types when runner-up in maidens Hamilton (5f, good to soft) and over C&D (good to firm) in June/July and made a good start to his nursery career when beaten only a neck in a 0-75 at Carlisle (5f, good) on Tuesday; pulled just over 3l clear of the third at Carlisle and is the one to beat if turned out again quickly.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Made a sound start to his nursery career when fourth to stablemate Lady Dublin over 6f at Thirsk (good to firm) three weeks ago, albeit not obviously shaping as if crying out for a drop back to 5f; wears first-time cheekpieces; has shown a tendency to start slowly.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has reached the frame on two of her three starts; looked suited by the drop to 6f (led for long way) when third in Lingfield maiden and it could be that the minimum trip sees her in an even better light on nursery debut.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Good third on nursery debut at Catterick (5f, good to firm) but well-held third third over 6f there a week later and she trailed throughout at Thirsk (6f again; Enemy Action ahead of her) since.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Her mark appears about right based on her two nursery efforts last month but she now returns to the scene of her fast-ground claiming success in May; also has a handy draw so there are reasons to be hopeful.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has hinted at ability on all three 5f starts and the return to a stiff track for nursery debut should suit having been taken off his feet at Catterick latest; also gets first-time blinkers; possible improver.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Stepped up on his first two efforts when keeping on for fourth (Kaiulani Spirit behind in fifth) over 5f at Catterick (good to firm) four weeks ago; the third gave that form a bit of a boost when winning a maiden at Thirsk last week; should be up to making an impact from an opening mark in the mid-50s.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Had two runs in nurseries last month, beaten just over 2l when third of seven over 5f at Lingfield (good to firm) latterly; being eased another 2lb can only help but it's not enough to tempt.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Hasn't built on his 5f debut in two subsequent 6f outings but more realistic chance now handicapping at a low level; has shown speed so the return to 5f could help, as may first-time blinkers.

RaceName: Welcome Racing TV Club Members Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Down the field in three 5f outings in recent weeks; more chance in this company but still hard to fancy from 6lb out of the weights.

Spotlight: Improved to make a winning start to her handicap career over the extended 7f at Ffos Las (good) 16 days ago, making virtually all under Mason Paetel; a 3lb rise shouldn't prevent another bold bid.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Best effort when second of 11 in 6f Ripon novice (good) eight weeks ago; mixed messages from that form but her pedigree provides hope that the longer trip could suit now handicapping.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Led close home to win 7f Musselburgh seller (good) in June; shaped best when short-headed in a C&D novice (good to firm) next time but hasn't reproduced that form when third in two nurseries back at Musselburgh since; needs to bounce back to her best.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Signs of ability in three qualifying runs over 6f; steps up in trip for nursery debut after five weeks off; all the more interesting if backed.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Improved when 0.75l third of six on 6f Chepstow nursery debut (good to firm) three weeks ago and her stablemate who won that race followed up back at Chepstow on Sunday; merits plenty of respect off an unchanged mark, particularly as the longer trip may help (dam 1m winner); Ollie Sangster's 6-11 Beverley record is another positive.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Has yet to build on her debut, including a remote fourth of six on last week's 7f Thirsk nursery debut; her claims aren't obvious (mark due to be 3lb lower from weekend).

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Only modest so far, including last of five (Amantha second) on C&D nursery debut (good to firm) six weeks ago; improvement needed.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Never a serious threat in three qualifying runs over 6f/7f; should stand more chance in nurseries but even an opening mark in the low-50s isn't obviously generous.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well held in three 5f/6f starts in the first half of the summer; gelded ahead of this handicap debut over a longer trip; worth a look in the betting.

RaceName: Hornsea Ladies At The Races Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten in three starts last month, including 7f; yard in form but she's best watched unless the betting hints otherwise

OwnerName: Mme Michele Blanc & Fal Stud SAS
Ecurie David R Layani Famille/Ecurie Des Charmes/Ballylinch
Ryszard Zielinski, Mme Alicja Karkosa & Andrzej Zielinski
D Scott, Resdev, Capla Dev & L Westwood
Spotlight: Fine runner-up efforts on two of his three starts this year and should give it another good go if fully tuned after ten weeks off.

Admirable 8yo who recorded his 11th win when surging clear on his reappearance at Catterick (6f, good to firm) under Tom Kiely-Marshall in May; not in the same form when last of five at Nottingham (6f again) since but he's bagged the inside stall on his first Beverley visit and is capable of bouncing back.
5f AW win in April; hasn't reproduced that in four subsequent turf outings but he's back on that last successful mark and has run well here before.
Runner-up off 2lb higher at Redcar (5f, good to firm) in June; respectable fifth (Castan sixth) of 12 at Thirsk (5f, good) 12 days ago; enters calculations for last year's winning yard.

Recorded his 13th turf win when scoring in good style at Haydock (6f, good to firm) in April; respectable fifth of ten at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) 13 days ago but he remains 4lb above the mark he defied at Haydock.

Has drawn a blank since scoring over C&D in July 2024 but he's on a dangerous mark and latest keeping-on fourth of 17 at York (5f, good to firm) was encouraging with a return to a stiff 5f in mind (all six wins here and at Pontefract).

York win last summer came off 18lb higher, which shows how things have gone in the meantime, and latest Nottingham third came in a weak four-runner race; the good form of the Nigel Tinkler yard is a positive but he needs to step up on his recent efforts.
Made all and held on in tenacious fashion at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; handily drawn but he faces competition for the lead on what is only the second 5f start of his career.

Sole win from 21 starts came at Newmarket (6f, good) in August 2024; also posted a couple of decent placed efforts last August but ended 2025 on a low note and off for ten months ahead of this reappearance; a watching brief is the percentage call.

OwnerName: Grange Park Racing XIII & Ruth Carr
Spotlight: Made all at Pontefract (5f, good to soft; has won on good to firm) in April; beaten only a head over C&D off 1lb higher in May and arguably unlucky not to go close at the least over C&D again last time, finishing well for fourth having met trouble at a crucial stage; his draw isn't ideal but still respected.

Won this in 2024 and landed a second C&D win when getting up late to see off nine rivals on good to firm last month; can have a line put through her subsequent effort here as she was repeatedly denied a clear run.
18l behind Mr Moonshine when tenth of ten at Chester latest (1m4f); slight ease still leaves him 4lb above his highest winning mark, and cheekpieces will likely need to inspire a career best.

Dual C&D scorer this summer, but over two years since he last took a Class 5; 9l behind Mr Moonshine at Chester last month, and an anonymous effort on Tapeta since; cheekpieces of all three 2026 wins are off.

Passed by Mr Moonshine close home when fourth at Chester latest, beaten under 1l and clear of Sisterandbrother and Return With Gold; well treated on 2024's peak form, but winless around any course this galloping.

Raw material is clearly there to win races over 1m4f and beyond, but couldn't have got more wrong at Doncaster latest, overcompensating for having again fluffed the start (beaten 75l); hood replaces blinkers.

Recent step up to 1m4f and fitting of cheekpieces has returned him to the level of his peak 2yo effort, and still had running left at the end of a slightly better Thirsk Class 5 than this last time; chance.

Has belied a pedigree not obviously conducive to middle distances in recording two recent near misses, including a neck third at Chester latest (1m4f, good) with three reopposing rivals held; chance off an unchanged mark, assuming no adverse reaction to the debuted cheekpieces.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
OwnerName: Buist, Shields, Thompson And Mrs R Carr
Spotlight: Hostage to fortune under his usual running style but defied trouble in running for both 7.5f wins here last year, one at this meeting off today's mark; should be coming to the boil after two staying-on efforts over that same C&D this term, and did win third time out in 2025; very interesting.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: Raced on turf only once since June 2025's Yarmouth handicap debut win (6f), going close over just shy of today's trip twice in the winter; no threat on either previous return from a triple-figure number of days out.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: Penultimate start had presaged an imminent breakthrough, and a first try over the 1m trip her dam won at duly reaped reward at Redcar last week (good to firm; RPR 59); case clear if over that effort; 1lb well in.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: A repeat of the form of either May's Doncaster 7f win (good to soft) or last September's second over today's C&D (soft) would see him go close; over four years now since his sole win on fast turf, however.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
OwnerName: Mrs Sally Doyle And Mrs Ruth Carr
Spotlight: C&D record read 14224 before June's below-par run, and a foray into classified company since bore no fruit either; wouldn't dismiss outright from this lowest mark he's ever raced off in a handicap, however.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: All but held on in a 7.5f fillies' maiden here a year ago, and best effort since came when a staying-on C&D fourth two runs back; claims on that, so long as a weakening effort at Hamilton last time is forgiven.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: 0-23; struggling to beat many home this turf season, faring no better for a step up to 2m at Redcar last time; others likelier.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: 0-18; more realistic assignment today following last week's Ripon novice tilt, but preceding efforts in handicaps fall some way short of the required; work on from out of the weights.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: Attainment level in handicaps not clarified by June's weakening 6l fourth here that perhaps owed more to racing wastefully than to the 1m2f (winners at that trip in immediate family); may learn more today.

RaceName: Racing Again On Saturday 29 August Handicap
Spotlight: Beaten favourite in the 7.5f nursery on this card last year, but better than a record of 1-23 might imply and she remains 4lb below her winning mark; likely goaded into overracing last time over a 1m2f trip she's still quite new to, and return to about 1m for now may do no harm.

OwnerName: Serge Tardy, Ecurie Melanie et al
Michael E Kisber & Omar Esmil Sh Ghrghar
Thierry Storme, Annua Racing SL et al

Spotlight: Dual hurdles winner got off the mark over fences for the first time at the eighth attempt at the Galway festival (2m2f, good); 4lb penalty for that could prove pivotal and his overall form doesn't suggest that a follow-up is guaranteed; trainer won this race last year though.

Won back-to-back handicaps at Cork (2m1f, good) and Tipperary (2m, good to yielding) in August/October; hasn't hit same heights since; unplaced in points and switch to chasing didn't bring improvement at Killarney last time when beaten 28l.

Dual-purpose sort; rated 112 over hurdles; was in the process of running a cracker when returning from 745 days off on his chasing debut at Wexford before falling at the last; pulled a long way clear with one other at Roscommon 13 days later when runner-up (2m1f, soft); this is another run relatively quickly but he looks like he has improved for fences.

Has hit top form recently; followed up an easy win in a weak Downpatrick maiden hurdle (2m2f, good) with success in a Sligo novice contest (2m2f, good); his rating of 120 over hurdles is the best on offer here but he must transfer it to fences on this chasing bow.

Bagged back-to-back mares' handicap hurdles in January/March at Down Royal and Leopardstown at 2m1f/2m3f on soft ground; form has dipped in three runs since, including when beaten 18.5l at Galway last time (2m1f, good); cheekpieces return and the tongue tie is new; one of the top rated over hurdles for this chasing bow but needs to bring her best.

Flat winner is 1-11 over hurdles, having been successful in a Leopardstown maiden hurdle in March (2m, soft to heavy); good runner-up finish to the smart Switch From Diesel in a Punchestown novice hurdle in June was his best run since (2m1f, good); makes chasing debut now and his hurdles rating of 115 gives him a shout but his recent runs have been a bit below his best.

Has won at Wolverhampton (9.4f, Tapeta) in four of his last six starts, including a comfortable success from a wide draw three weeks ago; up another 4lb but he still looks feasibly treated and this return to Polytrack should be fine; big player in hat-trick bid.

Won with cheekpieces added at Chelmsford (1m, Polytrack) in February but that was a seller and he's been well back in handicaps in three runs for his current yard; continues to drop down the weights but he's untried at this trip and others are preferred.

Has a patchy profile but he won at Newcastle (1m, AW) in March and was as good as ever when runner-up at Wolverhampton (9.4f) last time; only 1lb higher back on Polytrack and he could make another bold bid.

Ended a long losing run in first-time blinkers at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) in May and he's continued the good work with placed efforts in both subsequent runs (AW/turf); still looks on a workable mark and has claims if this sets up for his closing style.

Got back on the scoresheet with a runaway win over two rivals at Newmarket (1m2f, good to firm) in June; held in another small-field event at Epsom last time but that was a solid front-running effort behind an improver; still unexposed at this trip and he should be in the mix again back on AW.

Made it 2-3 in handicaps when scoring at Nottingham (1m2f, good) in June but he flopped with a laboured effort at Sandown (beaten 9l) last month; still lightly raced but he's a been a bit up and down so far and needs to bounce back again.

Made a bright start in handicaps, with a second at Beverley followed by 1m2f wins at Yarmouth and Leicester (both on good to firm); still unexposed after only seven starts but she didn't fire on turf here last time and needs to resume her progress back on AW.

Showed promise in novice events at Chelmsford last winter but he failed to beat a rival when 4-1 favourite on handicap debut at Wolverhampton (9.4f; cheekpieces added) last month; that was from a wide draw but he hung right and has bit to prove after that disappointing effort; first-time visor replaces cheekpieces.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)
Spotlight: She has struggled to recapture her 3yo best this term, latterly beaten 7l in a 1m2f Sandown handicap she won readily last year; today's drop back in trip and new cheekpieces could help, however, and this is probably her easiest task for a while; can't be ruled out from a dangerous mark.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)
Spotlight: Runner-up all three starts as a juvenile and after a miserable start to this season she was back in form when second again, this time at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) one week ago; still needs to prove herself at 1m, but she finished it off well last time and should be in the shake-up.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)
Spotlight: Took a decent step forward on his second handicap start when third at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) last Thursday; missed the break that day so better can be expected again if getting away on terms; player in his fresh cheekpieces.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)
OwnerName: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore
Spotlight: Exposed filly who has been in patchy form this year, including when beating one home over 1m2f at Windsor last month; drop back in trip will help, and she's 3lb below her last winning mark, but others look safer.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)
OwnerName: The 19th Hole Syndicate & J S Moore
Spotlight: Dual AW winner but he's yet to score on turf and his fair effort at Windsor (1m) in June was sandwiched by two moderate ones at 1m2f; return to this trip is a positive and there's nothing wrong with his mark but others hold more pressing claims.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)
Spotlight: Eight-time winner who likes it here, as evidenced by him winning an amateur riders' handicap (7f) for the second year in succession last time; stays this trip and has to enter calculations.

RaceName: Al Basti Equiworld, Dubai Apprentice Handicap (Whips Carried, But Not Used) (Racing Excellence)
Spotlight: Beat a rival for the first time this term when eighth of nine at Ffos Las nine days ago; still finished 16l adrift and he's impossible to recommend.

Dual 5f winner who ran well on his belated return to 6f here 17 days ago, finishing second to Madman despite taking a strong hold; Billy Loughnane has been aboard for both his wins and he now returns.

Maiden who has been disappointing since finishing second in a 6f sales race at Newmarket a year ago and was no match for the winner when second in a small field three weeks back (5f; second run in blinkers); makes handicap debut on ninth career start.
Both wins at 5f on Southwell AW; second at Leicester (6f) before a lesser show here 17 days ago when she got warm before the race; could be given another chance.
Back at 5f when going close in a maiden here recently; didn't really threaten in two handicaps prior to that, even when second at Lingfield; should run well but perhaps vulnerable.
Bath maiden winner last July (5.5f); lightly raced since and pretty poor in his last two starts.

Secured her hat-trick over 6f on soft and fast ground; only 2lb higher than for the last of those wins and it wasn't her fault when losing position quite early last time at Salisbury; needs considering.
Best of his three runs was on debut in a 7f novice at Doncaster; subsequent efforts leave him with much to prove on this handicap debut.
Won a 6f AW race in Ireland on second career start; close fifth on her handicap debut afterwards when tried in a hood that's been absent since (lost her way); sold in July for 3,000gns; others safer.
0-5 for Richard Hannon; successful seasonal/stable debut at Bath (5.5f, good to firm) in May but lesser performances have followed.
Hasn't looked on that good a mark since winning as a 2yo and ordinary of late, with and without headgear.
No match for Maid In Devon three runs back but probably his best form yet when beating Solar Invincible over C&D 17 days ago; 4lb rise is fair enough.

Rated 100 after five runs over fences; the latest of those was a positive third in a Roscommon handicap chase in August last year (2m6f, yielding) off 99; made winning stable debut in a Killarney handicap hurdle in May (2m4f, good to yielding); tailed off at Ballinrobe last time; most experienced of these but others probably more talented.

Placed in a point before falling in his second; 0-9 over hurdles but some okay runs in defeat; runner-up in a Cork handicap hurdle off 105 on stable debut in May; didn't match that in two subsequent outings; could do better over fences; not dismissed.

Point-to-point winner took the runner-up spot at Punchestown (2m3f, good to yielding) and Roscommon (2m5f, good) before running below his best at Galway (2m6f, good); ignoring his last run he's in good form, he has a healthy hurdles rating of 110 and he has a point background, so there's a lot to like.
Is 0-16 over hurdles and rated 100 in that sphere; nonetheless, his 9l fifth of nine at Killarney last month was one of his better efforts (2m5f, good); fences need to bring improvement.

Lightly raced; took well to fences when just run out of it late in a beginners' at Wexford in June; blinkers stay on and he looks like he will rate higher over fences compared to his hurdles rating of 102; interesting.

Shaped with promise in maidens but serious jumping issues evident on handicap debut at Clonmel in May (2m4f, good to yielding) and his tailed-off finish at Bellewstown last time (3m1f, good) was concerning; rated 107 over hurdles and this yard does wonders with horses over fences so not ruled out on first try chasing with a tongue tie added.

Enjoyed a purple patch last summer, winning three handicap hurdles on the bounce at 2m5f-2m7f on good ground; generally struggled since and his latest two runs have been fairly dismal; returns to chasing for the first time since 2024, when he didn't set things alight in three beginners'.

OwnerName: John Joseph Flynn & Conor Lannen & Mrs Miriam Queally
Spotlight: Beaten a long way in a bumper and four hurdle starts, the latest on handicap debut; mark of 97 over hurdles is possibly flattering so work to do on chasing bow.

OwnerName: Trevor Payne/One In A Million Syndicate
Spotlight: Rated 108 over hurdles; gained a first success at the 12th attempt over hurdles in a weak Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last time (2m3f, good); he's in good form for his chasing debut but others are more appealing.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: In need of the experience on his debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) and duly stepped forward when a front-running second of ten at Catterick (7f, good to firm) three weeks ago; sets the standard but he does have the widest stall to negotiate.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 22-1 and in need of the experience when down the field in a 6f novice at Salisbury (good to firm) 44 days ago; gelded since; should do better in time and the extra furlong is a plus.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 12,000gns yearling; sixth foal; closely related to 11.6f winner Three Priests (RPR 107), half-brother to three winners including Five Towns (7f/1m including 2yo/AW/US stakes; 111) and First Principle (1m/8.6f including 2yo/AW; 102); dam US 1m3f turf Grade 3 winner (100); looks the part on paper and he's a newcomer to take seriously.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Tailed off in two starts (5.7f, good and 7f, AW) in June; hard to recommend.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 14,000gns yearling; ninth foal; brother to 7f winner Name The Day (RPR 72), half-brother to winners Wedding Date (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; 93), Amicia (French 7f; 75) and Secret Potion (5f/6f including 2yo/AW; 74); dam placed over 6f on AW (53); stable have had a couple of 2yo winners this year so not discounted.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Second foal; half-brother to 7f/1m winner Born A Rebel (RPR 75); dam 1m AW winner (76), half-sister to useful 6f/7f winner De Bruyne Horse (including 2yo Listed); hooded for debut; 7lb claimer on board.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
OwnerName: M Reddy, J Mallon, N J Clayton & Partner
Spotlight: Modest form in two sprint runs on fast turf; easy enough to look elsewhere.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Given a BHA rating of 57 after three runs at up to 7f; she needs a big step forward if she is to take this.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Unplaced in two runs in fillies' only company, recording a peak RPR of 45; improvement essential.

RaceName: Follow @attheraces On X EBF Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (EBF Restricted Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Down the field in two 6f runs this summer; today's extra furlong isn't enough to tempt.

Tailed off at Kilbeggan on debut at 66-1; unlikely.

Has looked limited on the Flat, beating few rivals in four starts; tailed off at Limerick last time; hard to fancy.
One of two for trainer; well beaten in a bumper at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good); just slight improvement at Sligo when sent over hurdles (2m2f, good); others preferred.

Ran okay in an academy hurdle on testing ground at Naas in December, but better in a Kilbeggan maiden hurdle on good ground last month when taking the runner-up spot; entitled to improve on that as it came after a 221-day break and if she does she won't be far away.
Off the mark for Mark Loughnane with a comfortable success at Ffos Las (7.3f, good; eyeshield first time) last week; 2lb well in under a penalty but he has a wide stall to overcome.
C&D win last October off 2lb lower; had a wind operation prior to his seasonal return in June; two solid efforts this year and he's one to consider.

13 times a winner, three of them over C&D; in good form wheen last seen, including when second off this mark here in June; missed an intended C&D run last month after a controversial administrative error saw him withdrawn; high on the list.
Three AW wins this year, the latest here (6f) nine days ago; only 3lb higher under a penalty (1lb ahead of the handicapper) and he has form over a mile so this trip should be fine; one to consider.

Improved for the switch to handicaps/fitting of cheekpieces this spring, second at Southwell before winning at Kempton four days later (both 7f); best run since when fourth of ten in a Class 5 at Wolverhampton two weeks ago (blinkered first time); respected back down into a Class 6.
Four solid efforts this summer once fitted with a visor; should remain competitive.
Ran poorly at Wolverhampton in March but he ran some sound races on AW over the winter; returns from 136 days off with a visor back on for the first time since his debut.
Does a lot wrong in his races (often misses the break and/or pulls too hard) but he has two 7f AW wins to his name, including off this mark over C&D in April; others are more appealing this time.
Twice a runner-up from his six starts, most recently at Goodwood (7f, good to soft) ten weeks ago; he was beaten over 4l on that occasion though and a personal best is required.

She didn't progress for Jane Chapple-Hyam and then finished down the field in a 6f handicap at Newmarket on her stable debut 13 days ago; drops in class and returns to a longer trip so not discounted.

Improved for the switch to handicaps when finishing a head second in a 7f event at Wolverhampton last month; that form doesn't look overly strong, however, and she has a 2lb higher mark to contend with.
11-race maiden who hasn't matched his 2yo form this year; others look more persuasive.

2-5 in France, the wins coming at 1m on slow ground; later sold for 130,000euros and since had wind surgery; Billy Loughnane booked but the ground has to be a worry.

OwnerName: Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed Al Maktoum
Spotlight: The season started well but this front-runner has dropped away tamely in his last three races, albeit strong handicaps; this might not be so challenging and could go well if getting any freedom up front.
Won two in a row last May (1m, good) and is 7lb below his last winning mark; however, hasn't produced an effort of note since returning to Britain after a stint at Meydan.
Four-time turf winner; cheekpieces applied for final three races and after two thirds (1m) he got no luck in running at Chester; now having first run for Tom Ward and wouldn't rule out.

1m2f novice winner in April; rather disappointing afterwards but he was then well backed last time at Ayr (1m2f) and beat all bar an Ed Walker improver; 2lb higher with a tongue-tie added and firmly enters the reckoning; should be fine back at 1m.
A suspicion that 7f might suit him best but after starting slowly he did keep on over 1m at Newbury last time, albeit some 9l off the winner; the handicapper knows all about him.
1m novice winner at two and then gelded; slow starts weren't helping matters this season but raced in touch last time at Lingfield (1m1f) and they all bumped into an improver; could go well.
Came good at 11th attempt from off the pace over C&D in June (3lb lower) and the steady pace wasn't beneficial when last of the four at Epsom; consistent in the main.

Won a Kilbeggan handicap hurdle in 2024 for John McConnell; came back to form in first-time blinkers to easily win on the Flat here over 1m4f last time; has to be respected back hurdling assuming the blinkers have the desired effect again.
One-time useful dual-purpose sort when trained in UK; however, has been poor on his last three runs (two over hurdles) and others preferred.
Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner two years ago for former yard; has been consistent in defeat lately for this stable at around this trip and should run well again.
Maiden hurdle winner for Joseph O'Brien last year; similar runs in defeat at Killarney and Galway lately so has to find more even dropped 2lb.

Downpatrick hurdle winner in 2024 for Paul Flynn; came back from a long absence for this yard with a close second over hurdles at Wexford; got off the mark over fences since at the same track; should go well.
Hints of ability in maidens but has to improve plenty from handicap debut at Wexford last time when beaten 24l.

Spotlight: Won twice on AW earlier in the year; good second over C&D on Saturday when a visor replaced cheekpieces; bang there with a repeat.

Spotlight: Not at his best so far this year; returns from five months off with a point to prove.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Uncompetitive in three maiden runs this summer (6f, good to firm and 7f, AW); hard to recommend on bare form but he's bred to be smart and it would be no surprise to see marked improvement now dropped to this level; hood discarded this time.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: 125-1 when she did quite a bit wrong before finshing eighth of 13 at Goodwood (7f, good to firm; Siena Storm fourth, Clarity fifth) a fortnight ago; looks sure to prove better than that at some point, but might be one for further down the line.

RaceName: Tattersalls £40,000 EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: Become A Friend Of Racing Welfare Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: Become A Friend Of Racing Welfare Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: Become A Friend Of Racing Welfare Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Promise as a 2yo and again when in midfield on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f) last month; likely to be in the thick of it.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: In-form filly who scraped home at Hamilton (1m3f, good to firm) in June before going fairly close at Newcastle (12.5f, AW) one month later; goes up in grade again but she's getting better and needs respecting.

Spotlight: Prominent racer who is only a neck away from being on a five-timer, with two wins at Ffos Las supplemented by success at Leicester (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago; those wins came in small fields and this is a hike in grade but she's still a player; one of two for a yard that's ticking along nicely.

RaceName: British EBF Premier Fillies' Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Bar a soft-ground blip she's been in good form since switched to handicaps and she made the breakthrough over C&D (good to firm) 19 days ago; like stablemate Liveinthelight she goes up in grade but similarly has her best days ahead of her and warrants consideration.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Five turf wins but has done most of his winning on the AW; surprising to see blinkers back on having won in a visor at Chester last month and then beaten only 4l in a Class 2 handicap at Goodwood; if that doesn't backfire then has possibilities.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Four of his six wins have been at Chester where he nearly won again when last seen 11 months ago; trip/ground fine and on a fair mark, but market confidence would be welcomed after so long out.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Had gone badly off the boil but back in a Class 4 he came from behind to score narrowly at Chester (extended 1m2f); if he's turned a corner then likely to have some say off 3lb higher.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: This is a classier race than he's accustomed to but he's been in fine form since returning from a break and it was comfortable over C&D a month ago; 6lb rise demands another career best but couldn't put it past him.

RaceName: RIP Susan Procter Memorial Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressed well this year and was doing all his best work late when mid-division in a big field at Glorious Goodwood (1m); stays 1m1f and he'll probably stay this far; has more to offer.

Maiden ran well enough on second handicap start at Wexford last time but was still beaten 16l; needs a fair bit more off 2lb lower.
Maiden showed promise in four bumpers in 2024 and in two maiden hurdles last year; hit and miss this year and has to rebound from two poor runs.
Best handicap run came when beaten only 9l at Kilbeggan over 15.5f; carried out early at Killarney since; blinkers added today and should stay this trip; a player.
Was regressive over hurdles over the winter in testing ground; fell on stable/chasing debut last time; others make more appeal.

One of his three chase wins came here; has also claimed two hurdle races plus was runner-up in this race last year off 6lb lower;  pulled-up over fences at Galway last time but can bounce back over hurdles.
Maiden was a close third at Cork last month over 2m1f but was below that level since over the same C&D; has to rebound back up in trip.

Won a Sligo maiden hurdle last summer but has been mostly below that level since; better last time at Wexford in first-time cheekpieces over 3m; this trip suits better and could go well with the headgear retained.
Ran her best race over hurdles when fourth in heavy ground here in 2025; not a bad run at Cork last time over 2m1f; a squeak if staying this trip.
Third in a Cork bumper on debut last year but hasn't built on that over hurdles; is still worth a market check on handicap debut after a break with a tongue-tie added.
Point winner on soft ground ran his best race over hurdles when fourth over 3m at Kilbeggan last time; this shorter trip might not suit as well but still one to consider.
Mild promise in bumpers but not much over hurdles and isn't easy to make a case for her.
Has shown a hint of ability in bumpers and over hurdles but was beaten a long way in a Wexford handicap last time so others preferred.
Third in a Clonmel handicap over this trip on debut for this yard last October; has a shout if she can repeat that after a break.
Was beaten 20l over C&D in April but pulled-up next time at Punchestown; has to find improvement for a new yard.
Not a bad run at Kilbeggan over 3m but has to rebound from a poor effort over this trip at Killarney.

Spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt with an easy win in a novice at Catterick (5f, good to firm) last month; this is tougher off revised mark on nursery debut but he has a progressive profile and is bred to be useful; key player.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Showed clear promise with her placed efforts at Salisbury and Sandown (both at 5f on good) but she flopped with a 10l defeat in a Beverley novice last month; still early days but she needs to bounce back with a personal best on this nursery debut.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
OwnerName: Fairies At The Bottom Of The Garden Ltd
Spotlight: Placed in novice events at Nottingham (5f, good to soft) and Windsor (5f, good to firm) before a close fourth of six on nursery debut at Leicester (9-4 favourite) two weeks ago; still unexposed after only four starts but he needs to find something extra on this switch to AW.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Tailed off in her first two starts before a well-held fifth of nine in a novice at Kempton (6f, AW) last month; needs improvement now switched to a nursery but she showed plenty of speed last time and shaped as though this drop to 5f could suit.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Single-figure prices but he was beaten 5l, 6l and 7l in three maiden/novice events over sprint trips; now goes handicapping with a hood added but he needs a transformation on AW debut.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Didn't show much in his first two starts but he shaped with promise when fifth of 12 in a Southwell novice (6f, AW) last month; half-brother to a 5f Listed winner and he's an interesting contender dropped in trip on nursery debut.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Justified favouritism on nursery debut here (5f, good to firm) last month and the step back up 6f seemed to backfire on her return visit 12 days ago; could resume her progress back at this trip and she's out of an AW winner; in the mix.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Finished down the field in first three starts and he beat only one rival in the Super Sprint at Newbury (40-1) last time; this is more realistic on nursery debut but he needs blinkers to make a big difference.

RaceName: Download The At The Races App Nursery Handicap
Spotlight: Her best effort in novice/maiden events was a 4l sixth of ten at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on her second start; out of a 5f 2yo winner but she struggled at Chepstow last time and has something to prove on nursery debut.

Unexposed filly who won Doncaster novice (1m2f, good to firm) in June and it was a solid handicap debut when fairly close fourth at Chester (10.5f, good) three weeks ago; unraced at two and it will be disappointing if we've already seen the best of her.

After an encouraging debut she made good strides in three subsequent starts, winning a maiden (1m, AW), Bath novice and Nottingham handicap (also 1m2f, good to firm); handicapper couldn't go overboard after that latter success a fortnight ago; leading contender in bid for the four-timer.

Sauntered home in a June juvenile hurdle and, after getting turned over in similar event at Stratford six days later, he got up late to land four-runner handicap over C&D (good to firm) three weeks ago; first-time cheekpieces worn that day are retained and he's respected up 3lb.

7f novice winner here (good) last term who was outpaced before rallying well in a pair of 1m2f Sandown handicaps this year; step up to 1m4f didn't look the issue when he disappointed at Ascot last time, his trainer subsequently blaming the quick conditions; returns to this trip in added blinkers with a point to prove.

Looked good when winning twice on AW (1m/7f) in the spring but his form on turf doesn't bear comparison, albeit his last start on grass came in a warm handicap; proved underwhelming on AW last time and he now tackles a new trip with a question to answer.

Made a winning handicap debut on AW (7f) in April and he doubled his tally when landing Newbury handicap (1m, good to soft) in June; underperformed on good to firm over latter C&D last month and he was taken out due to quick conditions at Glorious Goodwood three weeks later; goes up in trip with a query surrounding this forecast ground.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who is 3-5 for current yard, all the wins coming on fast ground at Chepstow (1m2f-1m4f); won as she liked last week so could well make light of the penalty.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Carries a penalty for the Ffos Las win (1m, good) as he escapes one for winning an apprentice race over 1m2f here on Monday, which was only by a neck but he had to be switched; competes off the same mark and Billy Loughnane is back on; should have no trouble seeing out this longer trip.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Exposed but consistent and dug deep to prevail in a close finish over 1m2f here a month ago (they went steady); every chance off 2lb higher; third over this trip the time before.

RaceName: Classic Golden Music Group 10th Anniversary Handicap
Spotlight: Gelded ahead of his handicap debut at Sandown where he lacked the pace of the front two over 1m2f; this extra yardage can trigger some improvement.
Maiden in all spheres was tailed-off in a 1m4f Galway maiden on return for a new yard so can't be fancied on that showing.

Produced a solid effort on debut when a close fourth over 1m4f here last month; with improvement forthcoming she could turn the tables on the placed horses then, Kimy and Dream On Baby; this trip is a question on pedigree, though.

A 132-rated hurdler has run well in defeat on the Flat several times including when third over 1m4f here on return last month; however, was poor over hurdles at Galway since and has to rebound; the hood worn then is left off.

OwnerName: John J Flynn, Pierce Flynn, Conor Lannen
Spotlight: Won a Wexford bumper a year ago and has run some solid races in defeat over hurdles since including at Cork last time; beaten 10l in a Leopardstown maiden on sole Flat start; has a bit to find but can be involved.
Three-time hurdle winner stays 2m6f in that sphere and rated 110; beaten a long way on sole Flat start at Ballinrobe on return this year but can do better today.
Sole win over hurdles came here in 2024; also ran well on the Flat here when second in a 1m4f maiden when 1.25l ahead of Dream On Baby; well below that level at Galway since so has to rebound.

Has been in the form of her career this season, winning handicap hurdles at Ballinrobe and Kilbeggan before finishing a close third at Galway; now rated 129 in that sphere so has to be respected on Flat debut over a trip that will suit.
Bumper and dual hurdle winner up to 2m4f (rated 132); the best of two Flat runs when beaten 11l in a 1m4f maiden at Galway last time; this longer trip will suit better and is a big player.

Made all to win over hurdles here in May and bounced back from a poor Galway run to again make all to win a Wexford handicap hurdle six days ago; goes well here and should be a player but likes to get her own way in front.

Three-time hurdle winner ran her best race in that sphere when third in the Galway Hurdle last time; 7f was too sharp on her last Flat start but has a solid shout on the form of her Listowel fifth over 1m6f last September; big player.
